title: Session flash messages can disappear across server-rendered frames
author: brophdawg11
body_preview: ## Problem  Session flash messages can disappear while rendering nested frames.  Internal frame requests forward credentials and independently run session middleware. With server-side storage, an earlier response can save the session and clear its incoming flashes before another frame loads them.  This means a message can be available to the outer request but missing from its frame content. Flash...

title: assets: bare specifiers in `export … from` and dynamic `import()` are not rewritten
author: fff-fm-404
body_preview: ### What happens  `createAssetServer` rewrites a bare package specifier in a static `import` declaration to its served URL, but leaves it untouched in a re-export (`export { x } from 'pkg'`, `export * from 'pkg'`) and in a dynamic `import('pkg')`.
